title: Prepare the nominal logical encoder with locally admitted positive polymers
status_authority: Acquired completed root whole-read review accepts both all-level local admission and the later stronger rooted proposal at their explicit ideal-algorithm scopes.

scientific_scope_status: The completed root review accepts all-level local RX/RZ syndrome-history admission, including redundant constraints, unique zero-preserving histories and history weight at most four times top weight. A positive hard-core polymer sampler prepares the ideal nominal encoder within diamond error 2 epsilon. The finite-list engine is polynomial in n and 1/epsilon; the stronger rooted rational proposal has expected polynomial work in n and log(1/epsilon).

unavailable_or_unclassified: This improves the prior exponential proposal bound for ideal NOMINAL initialization. It does not initialize the noncommuting clock-gadget Gibbs environment, handle unknown charged errors or noisy preparation, or give a worst-case log(1/epsilon) runtime bound. Rare long rooted proposals remain; a cap restores a separate polynomial 1/epsilon guarantee. The ordinary all-zero approximation already meets the finite n1336, epsilon .01 example.
